issues.title: Incomplete Acceptance Criteria for Business Logic
issues.why: The ACs in 97-acceptance-criteria.md focus almost exclusively on meta-health (file existence, naming, changelogs) and DDL linting, but lack GWT criteria for the core functional requirements like ORM-only usage, View-first joins, and Split-DB implementation.
issues.fix: Add GWT criteria for ORM usage (AC-DB-009) and View-first joins (AC-DB-010) in 97-acceptance-criteria.md.

issues.title: Broken Cross-References to External Guidelines
issues.why: Multiple files reference '../02-coding-guidelines/01-cross-language/07-database-naming.md' and similar paths which are not provided in this context, making it impossible for an AI to verify the 'full specification' it is supposed to follow.
issues.fix: Inline the critical naming rules from the external cross-language spec into 01-naming-conventions.md.

issues.title: Concurrency and Locking in Split-DB Pattern
issues.why: The spec mentions SQLite WAL mode and 'no lock contention across domains' but provides no guidance on handling concurrent writes within a single domain's SQLite file for a 'mediocre' coder.
issues.fix: Add a section to 07-split-db-pattern.md specifying mandatory PRAGMA settings for SQLite concurrency (e.g., busy_timeout, journal_mode=WAL).
